checks.name: rustfs-upgrade
command:
set -euo pipefail
container_name=veoveo-rustfs-upgrade-test
cleanup_image=rustfs/rustfs@sha256:800cf3f352a0a27e3275ca854a51f0027975d7acc7a0d52089a35bcc9fcbf0b5
if docker ps -a --filter "name=^/${container_name}$" --format "{{.ID}}" | grep -q .; then
  echo "refusing to replace existing container ${container_name}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ss -ltn "sport = :19000" | tail -n +2 | grep -q .; then
  echo "TCP port 19000 is already in use" >&2
  exit 1
fi
test_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/veoveo-rustfs-upgrade.XXXXXX)
case "${test_dir}" in /tmp/veoveo-rustfs-upgrade.*) ;; *) echo "unexpected temp directory ${test_dir}" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
mkdir "${test_dir}/data" "${test_dir}/logs"
chmod 0777 "${test_dir}/data" "${test_dir}/logs"
cleanup() {
  docker stop --time 10 "${container_name}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  docker rm "${container_name}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  if [ -d "${test_dir}" ] && [ ! -L "${test_dir}" ]; then
    if docker run --rm --user 0 --entrypoint find --volume "${test_dir}:/inspect:ro" "${cleanup_image}" /inspect -xdev -type l -print | grep -q .; then
      echo "refusing to delete RustFS test directory containing symlinks" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    docker run --rm --user 0 --entrypoint find --volume "${test_dir}:/cleanup" "${cleanup_image}" /cleanup -mindepth 1 -xdev -depth -delete
    rmdir "${test_dir}"
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
start_rustfs() {
  image_ref=$1
  docker run --detach --rm --name "${container_name}" \
    --publish 127.0.0.1:19000:9000 \
    --env RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY=veoveo-upgrade \
    --env RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY=veoveo-upgrade-secret-not-default \
    --env RUSTFS_CONSOLE_ENABLE=false \
    --volume "${test_dir}/data:/data" \
    --volume "${test_dir}/logs:/logs" \
    "${image_ref}" /data >/dev/null
  for _ in $(seq 1 180); do
    if curl --silent --fail http://127.0.0.1:19000/health >/dev/null; then return; fi
    if ! docker ps --filter "name=^/${container_name}$" --format "{{.ID}}" | grep -q .; then docker logs "${container_name}" >&2 || true; exit 1; fi
    sleep 1
  done
  docker logs "${container_name}" >&2 || true
  exit 1
}
stop_rustfs() {
  docker stop --time 30 "${container_name}" >/dev/null
}
start_rustfs rustfs/rustfs@sha256:fa19210ac4697c79d7ccca1ec9b0eb91aebacc6691991ffb14014bb3c67e6cc3
docker run --rm --network host \
  --env AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=veoveo-upgrade \
  --env AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=veoveo-upgrade-secret-not-default \
  --env AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 \
  amazon/aws-cli@sha256:0425835c7c9e33a747dfd499dcd3603ec802662f7f7ded42d8fc81ce7b712bf9 \
  --endpoint-url http://127.0.0.1:19000 s3api create-bucket --bucket veoveo-upgrade >/dev/null
VEOVEO_RUSTFS_TEST_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:19000 \
VEOVEO_RUSTFS_TEST_BUCKET=veoveo-upgrade \
VEOVEO_RUSTFS_TEST_ACCESS_KEY=veoveo-upgrade \
VEOVEO_RUSTFS_TEST_SECRET_KEY=veoveo-upgrade-secret-not-default \
VEOVEO_RUSTFS_TEST_PHASE=write \
  cargo test -p veoveo-artifact-service --test rustfs_integration \
    multipart_range_and_restart_persistence -- --ignored --exact --nocapture
stop_rustfs
start_rustfs rustfs/rustfs@sha256:800cf3f352a0a27e3275ca854a51f0027975d7acc7a0d52089a35bcc9fcbf0b5
VEOVEO_RUSTFS_TEST_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:19000 \
VEOVEO_RUSTFS_TEST_BUCKET=veoveo-upgrade \
VEOVEO_RUSTFS_TEST_ACCESS_KEY=veoveo-upgrade \
VEOVEO_RUSTFS_TEST_SECRET_KEY=veoveo-upgrade-secret-not-default \
VEOVEO_RUSTFS_TEST_PHASE=verify \
  cargo test -p veoveo-artifact-service --test rustfs_integration \
    multipart_range_and_restart_persistence -- --ignored --exact --nocapture
stop_rustfs
